meta.statement: Written and committed to git before tools/calib.py confirm reads any 2024-2025 row. The choice per head below follows the decision rule on <= 2023 data only. The confirm stage scores it once on 2024-01-01..2025-12-31 (backtest universe, event-cluster CIs). The descriptive rows (each scheme family's 2016-2020 choice, run walk-forward through 2024-25) are reported for the record; by this pre-registration no 2024-25 number can change the choice, the decision rule or the production spec.

decision_rule: Per head and scheme family, the hyper-parameters are chosen by pooled log loss over the rolling origins 2016-2020 (each year predicted only from earlier fights, per-card refits where the scheme refits per card). A family passes the gate only if BOTH (a) its 2016-2020 choice and (b) its best configuration on the forward-chained years 2021-2023 beat the incumbent (ml2's own stack fit 2019..Y-1 with its CV half-life; the ML v2 logistic as published) by more than 0.0005 pooled log loss on 2021-2023 (ml2's selection rule). Among passing families the one whose 2016-2020 choice scores best on 2021-2023 is adopted; if none passes, the head keeps the incumbent (no recalibration). Fixed before any cv output was read; 2024-2025 never enters.

noline.incumbent: ml2 page stack ml2lr + mkt_rating, h 1.5, fit 2019..Y-1 (tools/ml2.py stage_stack)
noline.primary_metric: 2024-25 log loss of the chosen scheme (= the incumbent when nothing passed), with calibration slope, Brier and accuracy; paired vs the incumbent and vs the close

open.incumbent: ml2 page stack open + ml2lr, no recency, fit 2019..Y-1
open.primary_metric: 2024-25 log loss of the chosen scheme (= the incumbent when nothing passed), with calibration slope, Brier and accuracy; paired vs the incumbent and vs the close

line.incumbent: ml2 page stack close + ml2lr, no recency, fit 2019..Y-1
line.primary_metric: 2024-25 log loss of the chosen scheme (= the incumbent when nothing passed), with calibration slope, Brier and accuracy; paired vs the incumbent and vs the close

ml2lr.incumbent: ML v2 logistic as published (annual expanding refit), no recalibration
ml2lr.primary_metric: 2024-25 log loss of the chosen scheme (= the incumbent when nothing passed), with calibration slope, Brier and accuracy; paired vs the incumbent and vs the close

also_reported: per-family calibration slopes by year for 2024 and 2025 (the drift table's continuation)
ml2's own rolling page stacks (refit each January, monthly ML v2) as the deployed reference
